snippet.title: Island Market Simulator Trailer
snippet.description:
Island Market Simulator is live on Steam!

Run your farm by engaging in livestock and crop cultivation, then sell your products in the marketplace to become a true merchant. Plus, shape the game’s dynamics by balancing the relationships between the kingdom, pirates, and the people.

 

Add it to your wishlist now; the free demo version is coming soon!
